description: Search Antarum's catalog of 120+ robots by free text, category, use, price limit, status and the user's country. Returns each robot with the price for that country (approx when converted, plus what the price includes), status, the date Antarum last checked it and its Antarum page.

country.description: The user's country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, AT, US, GB, AE. Without it: international prices.

language.description: Language of texts and page links. Default: en.

max_price.description: Upper price limit in the currency of the user's country: EUR in Europe, USD in the USA, AED in the Gulf.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "robot dog with lidar", "humanoid for a trade fair", "Unitree".

name: search_robots
title: Search robots
